content: Recharts v3 is the default React charting library, 150KB, 2.4M weekly downloads. shadcn/ui ships an official Chart component built on Recharts v3 with no lock-in abstraction, best fit for projects already using shadcn/ui. Tremor duplicates shadcn role as a second design system. Visx is a low-level D3 toolkit, overkill for a KPI dashboard.
